senses.gloss: m. (preced. ws.) one who acts violently, a violent man.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 45a:6">B. Bath. 45ᵃ</cite> <he>סתם נכרי א׳ הוא</he> as a rule the gentile is violent (lawless).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 1:5:5">Y. Kidd. I, 60ᶜ</cite> top.—Pl. <he>אַנָּסִין אַנָּסִים</he>.

Ḥull. 94ᵇ מפני הא׳ on account of the lawless (among the gentiles).—Esp. (law) Annas, one who is in possession of property bought from one who obtained it by force or consfiscation, owner of reclaimable property.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 7:6">Kil. VII, 6</cite> (<cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 7:5">5</cite>) <he>הא׳ שזרע וכ׳</he> if an Annas put seeds into a vineyard (creating Kilayim), and it is reclaimed.

Ib. from what time and onward נקרא א׳ is one called an Annas (who may consider himself in undisturbed possession)? Answ. משישקע (v. Y. ib. 31ᵃ) from the time the name of the original owner is sunk (when the property is no longer named after him).—Pl. as above.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 4:2:2">Y. Succ. IV, beg. 54ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="E00759"><he>הֶפְקֵר</he></cite>.
